clues: A city sits in northern Sweden, near a river. That river forms the old border line for the north lands.
Its spot gives it a milder climate than most other towns in the north. That is a soft surprise for a place so far north.
Its charter came in 1446 from Christopher of Bavaria. It is the oldest town in all the north lands.
Each December, folks build a huge straw Yule goat here. It often makes world news when pranksters set the goat on fire.
The straw goat is now the symbol of this place. Folks use it to show off their town to the world.
